Turn on light. Use toilet. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry body with towel. Put on clothes. Turn off light.

Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Put away leftovers in refrigerator. Turn off light.
